doc: Per-structure display colours that override the layer colour in the Z engine (Base pages). The layer still decides visibility, the system controls, the peel and the legend row; only the drawn colour (and, where given, the opacity) of these structures differs. Each entry names base ids: a page id matches when it equals the base id or the base id + '_l' / '_r'. 'hex' is '#rrggbb', or '@<layer>' to take that layer's theme colour (follows light / dark). 'alpha' < 1 draws the structure translucent (at most its layer's opacity); below 0.35 a click passes through it, as through the skin. The user's own colour, the selection highlight and the radiographic styles win over this table. Injected into each Base page by scripts/anatomy/q364/colours_q364.py --inject (regen step).

entries.why: the white of the eye: dense collagen, off-white
transparent; drawn faint so the iris and pupil behind it show
pigmented iris, a natural brown (the pupil is the opening in this mesh; no separate pupil mesh exists)
pale, slightly yellow and translucent (light enough that the pupil still reads dark)
fine, nearly clear fibres between the ciliary region and the lens (opaque they drew a white hatched ring round the iris)
inner coat of the posterior globe, a deep red-brown: it is what the pupil opens onto, so the pupil reads dark
transparent gel filling the posterior segment
regions (spaces) of the globe, not tissues: near-transparent so they do not hide the iris, lens and retina
fibrous sling below the globe: ligament colour, not brain
the visual pathway keeps the nerve colour of the atlases (filed under the CNS layer because it is a brain tract)
the dense connective plates of the eyelids: pale lid tone, not muscle red
tear passages lined by mucosa: mucosa pink
dura mater, a tough fibrous membrane: off-white grey, not brain lavender (Q354 moved the spinal dura to the CNS layer)
